title: 第362章 久别重逢第361章 天道契约成
content_zh:
道无极，开局被困大阵最新章节_第362章 久别重逢第1页_道无极，开局被困大阵临淄的出云凉子_热点小说网
> 第362章 久别重逢（第1页）
多年隐忍，多年孤寂，多年思念，和在无尽海域这三年的惶恐，在这一刻尽数崩塌！
小玉娇躯剧烈震颤，多年强忍的思念与委屈，瞬间冲破所有克制。明明已是合体期修士，心境早已历经打磨、坚韧无比，可听闻追梦寻来的消息，温热的泪水瞬间决堤，顺着清丽的脸颊滚滚滑落，模糊了视线。
她以为还要蛰伏数十年、数百年，甚至更久，才能再见故人，却从未想过，追梦会跨越无尽海域亿亿万里，踏平无尽凶险，亲自闯入这人人忌惮的无尽内海，只为寻她与小兰。
一旁的小兰早已泣不成声，小小的身躯微微颤抖，眼眶通红，泪水源源不断滴落。无数个深夜的恐惧无助、无数次绝境中的咬牙坚持、无数回梦里的重逢期盼，此刻尽数化作滚烫的泪水，宣泄而出。
“追梦哥哥……是追梦哥哥来找我们了……”小兰哽咽呢喃，声音颤抖沙哑，满心皆是动容与狂喜。
一旁的贴身侍女们看着两位殿下泪流满面、情难自抑的模样，纷纷轻声劝慰，温柔安抚。
片刻之后，二女强压下心中汹涌的情绪，擦干脸上泪痕，眼底褪去所有柔弱，只剩下极致的坚定与欣喜。
多年的分离蛰伏苦修，终等来归期！
追梦表现出的绝对实力，在这无尽海域，甚至整个起源界，两人非常肯定，自己两人可以直接飞往追梦身前，不需要考虑别的，无需隐匿，无需躲藏！正如二女所想的一样，二女整理衣衫，收敛修为气息，不再有半分顾虑，带着一众侍女，径直踏出隐秘洞府。一路之上，所有海族生灵感知到二女的气息，正是归墟妖尊刚刚传达下来，不能招惹的两人，否则会为自身族群带来无尽毁灭，便无人敢阻拦分毫。
此刻，海域大战落幕、天地格局已定，追梦立身无尽海域边界上空，衣袂翻飞，静待佳人归来。
小玉和小兰二人一路畅通无阻，合体期1层的修为境界，带着十几名贴身丫鬟，全力飞行，横穿内海疆域，踏过外海迷雾，瞬息千里，快步奔向海域边界那道屹立于海天之间、身姿卓然的熟悉身影。
追梦的神识覆盖范围，远远望见两道熟悉的倩影踏海而来，一清冷决绝，一灵动温柔，眉眼依旧，只是褪去了年少青涩，多了几分强者的沉稳风华。
正是他日思夜想、跨越星海寻觅已久的小玉与小兰！
望着泪流满面、快步奔来的二女，追梦眼底漾开久违的温柔笑意，所有杀伐戾气尽数消散，也迎了上去，不然以二女的合体期1层的修为境界，飞行到他身前，需要很长一段时间，佳人在前，追梦多一秒的不想等，只想早点将二女揽在怀里。
多年分离，万般牵挂，今日，终得重逢。
待奔至二女身前，追梦轻轻抬手，拭去二人脸颊的泪痕，温声开口：“我来晚了，让你们受委屈了。”
小玉仰头望着他日思夜想的眉眼，哽咽摇头：“不晚，追梦哥哥，只要你来了，就不晚。”
小兰紧紧攥住追梦的衣袖，眼底满是失而复得的欣喜：“我们终于可以回家了。”

追梦轻轻颔首，伸手揽住二人，周身仙光流转，笼罩三人身形。
话音落定，鎏金虹光冲天而起，划破万里长空，带着历经劫难、终得团聚的三人，横跨亿万里山河，朝着邹府的方向疾驰而去。
山海亿亿万里，终有归期；岁岁相思，终得重逢。
自此，离散多年的故人，圆满团聚。

Dao Wuji, the latest chapter of Dao Wuji, who was trapped in the formation at the beginning_Chapter 362 Reunion after a long absence Page 1_Dao Wuji, Ryoko Izumo, who was trapped in the formation in Linzi at the beginning_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 362 Reunion after a long absence (page 1)
Years of forbearance, years of loneliness, years of yearning, and the three years of fear in the endless sea all collapsed at this moment!
Xiaoyu's delicate body trembled violently, and the longing and grievance she had endured for many years broke through all restraint in an instant. He was obviously a monk in the integration stage, and his state of mind had been polished and toughened. But when he heard the news about Dream Chaser, his warm tears burst instantly, rolling down his beautiful face, blurring his vision.
She thought she would have to hibernate for decades, hundreds of years, or even longer before she could see her old friend again, but she never thought that pursuing her dream would lead her to cross billions of miles across the endless sea, overcome endless dangers, and personally break into the endless inner sea that everyone was afraid of, just to find her and Xiaolan.
Xiaolan on the side had already burst into tears, her little body was shaking slightly, her eyes were red, and tears were dripping continuously. The fear and helplessness of countless late nights, the gritted teeth and perseverance in countless desperate situations, and the longing for reunion in countless dreams, all turned into hot tears at this moment and were vented out.
"Brother Zhui Meng... Brother Zhui Meng came to find us..." Xiaolan choked and murmured, her voice trembling and hoarse, and her heart was filled with emotion and ecstasy.
The personal maids on the side looked at the two royal highnesses with tears streaming down their faces and unable to control themselves, and they all whispered comfort and gentle comfort.
After a while, the two women suppressed the turbulent emotions in their hearts, wiped away the tears on their faces, and all the weakness in their eyes faded away, leaving only the ultimate determination and joy.
After many years of separation and dormant cultivation, we are finally waiting for our return!
With the absolute strength shown by Zhui Meng, in this endless sea, and even in the entire world of origin, the two of them were very sure that they could fly directly to Zhui Meng without thinking about anything else, no need to hide, no need to hide! Just as the two women thought, the two women arranged their clothes, restrained their cultivation aura, no longer had any worries, and walked straight out of the secret cave with a group of maids. Along the way, all the creatures of the sea tribe sensed the auras of the two women. They were the two women who had just been conveyed by the Guixu Demon Lord and were not to be provoked. Otherwise, they would bring endless destruction to their own tribe, and no one dared to stop them in the slightest.
At this moment, the battle in the sea area has come to an end and the pattern of heaven and earth has been decided. Chasing Dream stands in the sky above the border of the endless sea area, his clothes are flying, waiting for the return of the beautiful lady.
Xiaoyu and Xiaolan had an unobstructed journey. They were at the first level of cultivation in the integration stage. They took a dozen personal maids with them and flew with all their strength, crossing the territory of the inner sea, stepping through the fog of the outer sea, thousands of miles in an instant, and quickly rushed towards the familiar figure standing between the sea and the sky at the edge of the sea.
Chasing Dream's consciousness covered the area, and saw two familiar figures walking across the sea from a distance. One was cold and decisive, the other was smart and gentle. Their eyebrows were still the same, but they had lost their youthfulness and gained a bit of the calm elegance of a strong man.
It was Xiaoyu and Xiaolan whom he had been looking for for a long time across the sea of ​​​​stars, thinking about them day and night!
Looking at the two girls running towards him with tears streaming down their face, a long-lost gentle smile appeared in Zhui Meng's eyes. All the murderous and aggressive aura dissipated and he rushed towards him. Otherwise, with the two girls' cultivation level at the first level of the fusion stage, it would take a long time to fly to him. With the beauty in front, Chai Meng didn't want to wait for one more second. He just wanted to hold the two girls in his arms as soon as possible.
After years of separation and all kinds of worries, today, we finally meet again.
After running to the two girls, Zhui Meng gently raised his hand, wiped away the tears on their cheeks, and said in a warm voice: "I came late, and I made you feel wronged."
Xiaoyu raised her head and looked at his eyes, which were thinking about her day and night. She choked and shook her head: "It's not too late, brother Zhui Meng, as long as you come, it's not too late."
Xiaolan clutched Zhui Meng's sleeves tightly, her eyes filled with the joy of regaining something: "We can finally go home."
Zhui Meng nodded gently, stretched out his arms to hug the two of them, and the fairy light flowed around him, covering the three of them.As soon as the words were said, a gilded rainbow light rose into the sky, piercing the sky of thousands of miles, carrying the three people who had gone through the disaster and finally reunited, across hundreds of millions of miles of mountains and rivers, and rushed towards the Zou Mansion.
Traveling hundreds of millions of miles across mountains and seas, we will eventually return; we miss each other year after year, and we will eventually meet again.
Since then, old friends who have been separated for many years have been reunited.
